## Tables

```{r}
## Full Summary Table, to be combined with Region Table below
summary_table <- D19 %>%
  group_by(Data_source,Study_name_clean,Layman_group,  Sample_motivation, Sum_Method) %>%
  summarise(
    Observations = n(),
    Date_range = paste0(
      format(min(as.Date(Year_clean, format = "%Y"), na.rm = TRUE), "%Y"),
      " - ",
      format(max(as.Date(Year_clean, format = "%Y"), na.rm = TRUE), "%Y")
    ),
    Max_Total_PAH = max(Total_PAH, na.rm = TRUE),
    Min_Total_PAH = min(Total_PAH, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Total_PAH = mean(Total_PAH, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_Total_PAH = median(Total_PAH, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Layman_group, Data_source)
write_xlsx(summary_table, "OSRI_Table1.xlsx")

#Table 1 with regions defined (different data set)
summary_table <- D20 %>%
  group_by(Data_source,Study_name_clean,Layman_group,  Sample_motivation, Sum_Method,Region) %>%
  summarise(
    Observations = n(),
    Date_range = paste0(
      format(min(as.Date(Year_clean, format = "%Y"), na.rm = TRUE), "%Y"),
      " - ",
      format(max(as.Date(Year_clean, format = "%Y"), na.rm = TRUE), "%Y")
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Layman_group, Data_source)
write_xlsx(summary_table, "OSRI_Table1region.xlsx")

#Condensed Version of Table 1
summary_table_condensed <- D19 %>%
  group_by(Data_source,Study_name_clean, Sample_motivation, Sum_Method) %>%
  summarise(
    Layman_groups = paste(unique(Layman_group), collapse = ", "),
    Observations = n(),
    Date_range = paste0(
      format(min(as.Date(Year_clean, format = "%Y"), na.rm = TRUE), "%Y"),
      " - ",
      format(max(as.Date(Year_clean, format = "%Y"), na.rm = TRUE), "%Y")
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(Data_source, Sample_motivation)
write_xlsx(summary_table_condensed, "Tables/OSRI_Table1condensed.xlsx")
```
